_readme: Ye file edit karke poori site ka content badal sakte ho. Change karne ke baad site refresh karo (ya `node build.mjs` chalao). Price daalni ho to packages ke price field me daal do — khaali chhodo to 'On Request' dikhega.

about.heading: Behind the work
about.body: Main AI aur editing dono use karke aise video ads banata hoon jo bina badi shoot ke bhi premium lagen aur actually sell karen. Brand commercials se lekar UGC tak — fast, affordable, aur performance-focused.
